### Orange Logic is a leading provider of digital asset management software.

The Orange Logic DAM platform helps the world’s largest organizations unite teams, automate workflows, and manage everything from search to rights with Agentic AI, delivering faster insights that boost efficiency and drive growth.

![Orangelogic Landscape 3 digital pen and tablet](https://www.sagemount.com/media/305bwqaj/orangelogic_landscape_3.jpg?width=1440&height=960&quality=90&v=1db13467e16e630)

#### "This investment comes on the heels of Orange Logic’s remarkable growth over the past few years – which wouldn’t have been possible without the incredible work of our talented team and passionate customers. Their focus on solving important problems that affect nearly every digital-first organization is what has made us a leader in DAM software. We’re excited to partner with Sagemount to continue empowering our employees to serve our customers and grow our market presence."

Karl Facredyn

Founder - Orange Logic
